clue.text: Actual wild boar found first living in the woods

indicators.note: something wild is untamed and disordered, so the letters of the next word run free into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
actual means real, genuine

explanation.surface: A genuine wild boar was first spotted in the forest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'found first' tells you the scrambled boar comes before the word for actual.
explanation.definitionFit: Arboreal describes creatures that live in trees, as squirrels and monkeys do.

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a northern English word for a brook

explanation.surface: A ripple moving along a running brook.
explanation.walkthrough: A beck is a small stream in the north of England; the gesture sense survives in 'beck and call'.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a summoning gesture of the hand and a small mountain brook in northern English dialect.

indicators.note: something seen in a place sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: the Dee, a river in Scotland and another on the England-Wales border
taken as written

explanation.surface: Account for a fin spotted in the water.
explanation.walkthrough: The Dee is a favourite crossword river; FIN goes between its first and last two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To define something is to state its meaning precisely, which is a way of explaining it.

indicators.note: a new composition puts existing letters together afresh in a different arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A composer mangles a newly written piece of music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Composition' looks like part of the music picture but joins 'new' as the signal to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Franz Schubert was an Austrian composer of songs, symphonies and chamber music.

parts.note: surface reading: a benefits cheat collecting state money for an invented disability
setter's reading: anyone who pretends to be ill, for whatever gain, such as skipping work

explanation.walkthrough: The clue points at welfare fraud, but the word covers anyone who shams illness to dodge duty; the question mark flags the narrow example.
explanation.definitionFit: A malingerer feigns or exaggerates sickness to avoid work, so they falsely claim to be disabled.

clue.text: Sources of very attractive ladies' underwear, exceptional sale prices

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, so only its opening letter is used

parts.words: very attractive ladies' underwear, exceptional sale
parts.note: the opening letters of these six words

explanation.surface: A shop advert for alluring lingerie at bargain sale prices.
explanation.walkthrough: The lingerie advert is all padding: only the initials of the six words matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Values are the worth or cost put on things, so they can stand for prices.

clue.text: We're told it's the shortest cheese fair in Germany

parts.note: a soft French cheese
Fest is the German word for a festival or fair

explanation.surface: Someone hears that a German cheese festival lasts hardly any time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'We're told' hints the two words are heard run together: a cheese fair said as one word is the superlative of brief.
explanation.definitionFit: Briefest is the superlative of brief, meaning lasting the least time, the shortest.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: slang for a watch or clock, which ticks
second meaning: slang for the heart, which beats like a clock

explanation.walkthrough: Read together it suggests a mechanical organ; separately, both are slang senses of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: Ticker is informal for a timepiece with ticking works and also for the heart, the body's pumping organ.

indicators.note: a wrecked thing is broken up, so the letters are knocked out of their order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged
a vat is a large tank for liquids

explanation.surface: Instructions to fasten a crashed car to a military tank for towing.
explanation.definitionFit: A cravat is a broad neckcloth worn knotted at the throat, a kind of necktie.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to cut short, as with a tail or wages
second meaning: a place where boats tie up

explanation.surface: An order to cut the jetty down to size.
explanation.definitionFit: To dock is to cut short, as with a dog's tail, and a dock is also a quay or landing place for ships.

parts.note: to be in is to be at home
discreet means careful, wary

explanation.surface: Someone reckless in public who is careful in private.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface sets up a contrast, but the answer simply joins the home word to its opposite of reckless.
explanation.definitionFit: Incautious means rash, taking no care about risk, which is what foolhardy describes.

clue.text: Lash out at insect flying round informer

indicators.note: an insect flying round something circles it, so one piece is wrapped about another

parts.note: a bee is an insect
a rat is slang for an informer

explanation.surface: A wasp buzzing about angrily attacks someone who grassed.
explanation.walkthrough: The insect is split after its second letter to take the informer inside; a rat is slang for someone who betrays others.
explanation.definitionFit: To berate is to scold someone angrily, the verbal version of lashing out at them.

parts.note: a solution is an answer; the 's means 'is' and joins
able means clever, competent

explanation.surface: Praise for a puzzle solution that is smart and reliable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being answerable for something means being accountable, which is to be responsible for it.

clue.text: Wake up! Green is off the point!

indicators.note: something off is not right, so the letters are put into a corrected order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
a point of the compass: East

explanation.surface: A shout to rouse a golfer whose ball has run off the green.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Wake up!' is a command, matching the imperative verb. The compass point E joins the rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To energise is to give vigour to, rousing someone into activity as a call to wake up does.

parts.note: surface reading: what studying while wearing very few clothes is like
setter's reading: split the answer in two and it describes having fewer garments on the body

explanation.surface: Studying a book while wearing very little.
explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into two words and it describes someone with fewer clothes on.
explanation.definitionFit: A lesson is a passage of scripture read aloud in a church service, so it is a reading.

parts.note: an origin is a source
Al is the chemical symbol for aluminium

explanation.surface: Where aluminium was first obtained.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Source' looks like the definition but supplies the start; the definition is the last word.
explanation.definitionFit: The original version of something is the earliest one, the first from which others derive.

clue.text: On returning, find ruts all over the yard. Tough!

indicators.note: returning means going back the way you came, so the letters run right to left

parts.note: yd is the abbreviation for yard
taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone back home discovers the garden furrowed by wheels and grumbles about it.
explanation.walkthrough: Put the ruts over (after) the yard abbreviation, then read the lot backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Sturdy means strongly built and robust, which is what tough means of a person or object.

clue.text: Misprint, surely, of a part of speech

definitions.note: a pronoun is one part of speech, and this word is a pronoun

indicators.note: a misprint puts letters in the wrong places, so these letters are typeset in a new order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A grammar text has surely misprinted one of its word classes.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is by example: the answer is a reflexive pronoun, one kind of part of speech.
explanation.definitionFit: Yourself is a reflexive pronoun, and pronouns form one of the grammatical word classes.

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the racehorses kept by one stable or trainer

explanation.surface: A run of horses that share a stable.
explanation.definitionFit: A string is a sequence of things and also the group of racehorses belonging to one owner or yard.

parts.note: the face of a building is its front
elevation is a raising, a lift

explanation.surface: Refurbishing the front face of a building, as an architect's elevation shows it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Front elevation' is an architect's drawing of a facade, so the clue reads as one building term.
explanation.definitionFit: A facelift is figuratively a refurbishment that improves the look of a building or product.

clue.text: Maybe leap around? Exercise has its attraction!

indicators.note: around means surrounding, so the rearranged word is wrapped about the following piece
maybe signals uncertainty, so the next word's letters are not to be trusted in their given order

parts.note: the word rearranged, though it has an E where a second A is needed
PE is physical education

explanation.surface: Jumping about as exercise has its own charm.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged word should wrap PE, but leap has an E where the answer's outer letters need a second A, so the wordplay is one letter out; definition and crossings confirm the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Appeal is the quality of being attractive or interesting, so it means attraction.

indicators.note: a thing found in another sits inside it, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a purse is a small bag
U sounds like you, as in text speak

explanation.surface: A dog of yours discovered stuffed in a handbag.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dog' is a verb here, meaning to follow, not the animal.
explanation.definitionFit: To dog someone is to follow them persistently, which is what pursue means.

clue.text: Wing of first duck disappearing from view

indicators.note: what disappears from something is no longer there, so it is taken out

parts.note: a view is an opinion
a duck is a score of nothing, O; first places it at the start

explanation.surface: A duck's wing vanishing out of sight.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a duck is a score of zero, hence the letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: A pinion is the outer part of a bird's wing, and by extension a wing itself.

clue.text: Vision of piano part I play

indicators.note: to play is to treat freely, so the letters are moved about into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A pianist's image of the passage they will perform.
explanation.definitionFit: An apparition is a ghostly figure or vision, something seen that may not be real.

definitions.note: a dash is one mark of punctuation
definitions.meaning: second meaning: a horizontal punctuation mark

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as one phrase about writing style; split, it is two separate meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash means verve and flamboyant style, and it is also the name of a line used as a punctuation mark.

parts.note: d is the abbreviation for daughter

indicators.note: about can mean round in a different way, so the following letters are turned into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A daughter who is currently going through a low patch.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling down is an idiom for being sad or low in spirits, which is dejected.

clue.text: Father having the Spanish (and French) dish

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for father
el is 'the' in Spanish
la is 'the' in French

explanation.surface: Dad eats the Spanish dish, and a French one too.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' does double duty: Spanish EL, then French LA.
explanation.definitionFit: Paella is a Spanish rice dish cooked with saffron, seafood or meat.

parts.note: worthy means good, virtuous
a last will and testament

explanation.surface: Fine evidence of a lasting friendship.
explanation.definitionFit: Goodwill is a friendly, helpful attitude, the kindly feeling that friendship involves.
